t: The Forge Charging Port allows you to use the energy stored in your Turbine to charge items that use the the Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors:misc/powersystem)power system$(/l) to function.$(br2)Open the graphical interface of the port and insert the item you want charged into the input slot in the center.
Forge 充能端口允许你使用涡轮机中储存的能量，为依靠 Forge Energy $(l:bigreactors:misc/powersystem)供能系统$(/l)运行的物品充能。$(br2)打开端口的图形界面，然后将你想充能的物品放入中央的输入槽位。

Once the item energy buffer is full, the item will be automatically moved to the interface output slot for you to collect.$(br2)If, for any reason, you need to stop the charging process, press the eject button to move the item to the output slot immediately.
当物品的能量缓冲区充满后，物品会自动移动到界面的输出槽位，供你取出。$(br2)如果你因任何原因需要停止充能过程，按下弹出按钮即可立即将物品移到输出槽位。
$(l)Mandatory:$() no$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() any face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Variants:$() all$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes
